profile.name: Saeed Muhammad
profile.department: Dept. of Engineering Science, The University of Electro-Communications
profile.intro: I simulate two-electron atoms in strong fields.
about: I work on few-body quantum systems driven by external fields. Most of my research is on helium, where electron correlation creates doubly excited states that one-electron pictures cannot explain.
I write and validate my own codes, mainly in Fortran and Python, and develop and validate analytic and semi-classical theories against full numerical solutions of the Schrödinger equation.

facts.v: Doubly excited states, resonances, strong-field ionization, tunnelling
TDSE, complex scaling, perturbation theory, Fano theory, WFAT

news.text: Talk at IWTAQD 32 on channel-resolved photoelectron momentum distributions of doubly excited helium.
Poster at IWTAQD 29, University of Toyama: tunneling ionization of doubly excited states of helium.
Doctoral interim poster presentation at UEC.
Joined the Morishita group at UEC Tokyo.
